items: Low-pressure, pool-type design with no boundary penetrations below the primary coolant operating level

Seismic isolation of the reactor from the supporting structure
Location in a subgrade reinforced concrete structure
Passive emergency core cooling by natural circulation and natural convection air cooling

body.text: The GV provides a defense-in-depth coolant and functional containment boundary if the RV leaks.
body.anchor: which provides a defense-in-depth coolant and functional containment boundary

body.text: The RV-GV annulus is inerted with argon gas from the SCG to minimize sodium-air reaction.
body.anchor: The annular space is inerted with argon gas minimizing the potential for sodium-air reaction

body.text: If the RV leaks, the equilibrium RV and GV sodium level remains above the IHX inlets, so heat still reaches the intermediate system or RAC.

body.text: The GV also keeps sodium away from RXB concrete and the surrounding atmosphere.

title: Reactor Enclosure System
subject: RES
intro: The Reactor Enclosure System is the vessel, head, internals, guard vessel, and supports. It holds the pool, forms a barrier, and shapes the flow path.
